opening.speaker: Julian
opening.text: Hey, Sister Lena! If we don't get out of here quickly, things are going to get really bad. I heard the Altean knights have arrived at the foot of the mountain. Now's our chance to escape. Please keep going! Hang in there!

opening.speaker: Lena
opening.text: I'm sorry... But I left my precious Mend staff behind. I have to get it back... Julian! Forget about me and just escape yourself! If it's just you, I can transport you away to safety with my Warp staff.

opening.speaker: Julian
opening.text: That's not going to happen. If we did that, what would have been the point of me betraying them? ...Anyway. I will get the staff back later. For now, just focus on escaping! Come on, let's go!!

recruit_navarre.speaker: Caeda
recruit_navarre.text: Swordfighter Navarre! Why would a person like you become a bodyguard for these bandits?

recruit_navarre.speaker: Navarre
recruit_navarre.text: ...!? Who are you? I have no business with women or children! Get out of here immediately!

recruit_navarre.speaker: Caeda
recruit_navarre.text: Please, stop this unnecessary fighting... Please lend your strength to us. If you're unwilling, then do whatever you want to me with that sword.

recruit_navarre.speaker: Navarre
recruit_navarre.text: ...I will not strike a woman down with my sword. If you want me so much that you're willing to risk your life, I don't have a choice... I will lend my strength to you.

village_devil_axe.speaker: Mountain Elder
village_devil_axe.text: Hoho! You're looking very lively, young man! Since you've come this deep into the mountains, I will give you this axe as a souvenir. What do you think? Isn't it impressive? However... This is a Devil Axe, a demonic axe that draws blood from its user and strips their flesh. You must never use it!

house_mercenary_tip.speaker: Villager
house_mercenary_tip.text: Be careful of Mercenaries. They're very skilled, so if you're careless, they'll cut your head off with one strike.

boss_hyman.startCombat: So you guys want to die? I'll grant your wish!
boss_hyman.death: You... you will pay for this in blood...

ending.speaker: Jagen
ending.text: Look, your highness. We found 10000 Gold inside the castle that the bandits left behind. With this, we can get some new equipment.

ending.speaker: Marth
ending.text: Excellent! Tomorrow we will reach Aurelis. Please get a good rest tonight.
